force.description: Also unenrolls agents that are enrolled in hosted agent policies or are managed agents. Does not revoke API keys immediately. To do so, also set `revoke`.

includeInactive.description: When passing agents by KQL query, unenrolls inactive agents too

revoke.description: Immediately invalidates the API keys of the agents without notifying them. The agents keep running and can still send data to outputs not covered by the invalidated keys, such as Kafka and Logstash. Remote Elasticsearch keys are invalidated by Fleet Server on a best-effort basis. This action cannot be undone. Use it only for offline or compromised agents.
